summary_en: This study tests ivermectin given together with an immune checkpoint inhibitor, balstilimab or pembrolizumab, in people with metastatic triple negative breast cancer or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer. Ivermectin is taken by mouth on days 1-3, 8-10, and 15-17 of each 21-day cycle, and balstilimab or pembrolizumab is given intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle. Treatment continues until disease progression, intolerable side effects, withdrawal of consent, or up to 35 treatments or 2 years of the immunotherapy, whichever comes first. The record does not state a primary outcome; it describes a Phase 1/2 study of side effects and best dose, with secondary measures that include objective response rate and progression-free survival.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ivermectina administrada junto con un inhibidor de puntos de control inmunitario, balstilimab o pembrolizumab, en personas con cáncer de mama metastásico triple negativo o cáncer de mama metastásico HR+/HER2-. La ivermectina se toma por vía oral los días 1-3, 8-10 y 15-17 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el balstilimab o el pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días. El tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, efectos secundarios intolerables, retiro del consentimiento, o hasta 35 tratamientos o 2 años de inmunoterapia, lo que ocurra primero. El registro no indica un resultado principal; describe un estudio de Fase 1/2 sobre efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, con medidas secundarias que incluyen la tasa de respuesta objetiva y la supervivencia libre de progresión.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 1 or less.
Biopsy-proven metastatic triple negative breast cancer or HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
Progressed on 1 to 2 prior lines of systemic therapy in the metastatic setting.
Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST 1.1.
not_for: Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Pneumonitis that required steroids in the past, or current pneumonitis.
Immunodeficiency, or chronic steroid use above 10 mg prednisone daily, or other immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days before first dose.
Known HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
